question: Identify the organelle present in plant cell that is not there in an animal cell.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plastids**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Plastids** are present in plant cells but are absent in animal cells.
 
• These organelles are involved in the synthesis and storage of food.
 
• Plastids include chloroplasts, which are essential for photosynthesis, a process unique to plant cells.
